title: rolling cushioned chair
text: rolling cushioned chair. I purchased this for a masterbath vanity... I chose the white and it is a soft white - perfect for my use.  It is a faux leather that I am hoping will be easy to wipe clean with a gentle cleanser when needed.  Time will tell. There was an odor when I opened the box, but it has dissipated significantly with the chair out of the box.  It came nicely packaged with the main cushion encased in thin, but effective, shipping slipcover.  While it says it can hold up to 450 lbs (yikes) the chair itself and the seating area is actually small.  So if you are a bigger (wider) person, it may not be your first choice.  It's not as soft and cushy as I was hoping, but it will work.  Now, the assembly.... I was really disappointed.  It would have been SO easy to have the wheels already attached in the way that it was shipped!  But no.  You have to install the wheels - and you WILL need a rubber mallet.  The wheels are literally impossible to install without one.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
